name: catalyst_open_world_enzymarc_mmseqs_baseline_v1
role: strong reproducible same-task baseline evaluated before spending GPU on Catalyst external decoy features
query_support: all sequence-form-gate-eligible functional parents plus every released eligible EnzymARC decoy category
target_support: all clean2023 training proteins annotated to any retained target reaction
score: for each candidate sequence and target reaction, maximum MMseqs2 reported fractional sequence identity over clean2023 proteins annotated to that reaction

coverage_guard.required: the original parent accession must appear among the reported hits for every candidate derived from that parent
coverage_guard.if_missing: do not read aggregate performance metrics; perform a deterministic reaction-conditioned rescue search only for the affected query/reaction support, then finalize once coverage is complete
